THE DESIGN LINE

Unified where it helps.
Native where it matters.

KPro standardizes the hard runtime work—startup, shutdown, backpressure, readiness and telemetry—while HTTP remains HTTP, gRPC remains gRPC, and message transports share a focused Message / Context model.

ONE PROCESS, CLEAR OWNERSHIP

The runtime you would otherwise build twice.

Compose independent transports behind a dependency-neutral server. Each layer owns one job, and every boundary stays visible.

HONEST BY DEFAULT

Engineered for trials.
Validated by your workload.

KPro has repository-level tests, race-sensitive coverage, transport conformance helpers and benchmark budgets. It does not claim your production capacity, availability or compatibility before you measure them.
